subject: Token budget & SLO options for PoC with Atlas Analytics
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@atlasanalytics.com>, Priya Singh <priya@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T22:10:00Z
Subject: Token budget & SLO options for PoC with Atlas Analytics

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the concrete asks we discussed so we can size the PoC and pricing bands.

Summary of what you shared:
- MAU: ~40k active users; peak concurrency ~1,200 requests/min.
- Avg prompt: 220 tokens; Avg completion target: 380 tokens => ~600 tokens per request.
- Expected steady-state monthly volume: 1.2B tokens; potential ramp to 3B in 3–6 months.
- Latency goal: p50 ~200ms, p95 target <=600ms. Some endpoints OK with streaming for perceived responsiveness.

Questions we need to confirm for pricing and config:
1) Target budget range for PoC (monthly): you mentioned ~$5k–$12k but said you'd confirm — please confirm a firm band.
2) Target $/1M tokens you'd consider acceptable for evaluation (ballpark). That helps us propose Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Typical trade: Hosted/standard tier runs ~X per 1M, Dedicated reserved pools bring that down.
3) Which endpoints require strict p95 vs those where streaming + partial results are acceptable?
4) Can you share a sample traffic file (CSV) with per-request token distribution? Attaching our sample_traffic template — helps us simulate batching.

Our initial recommendation (for discussion):
- If your budget target is <= $10k/month for the PoC: start Hosted standard with aggressive prefix caching + 1–2 model variants; tune batching to 40–60ms batch windows to avoid p95 spikes.
- If budget target is >= $15k/month or you expect 2–3B tokens: Dedicated small pool (reserved) with 16–32 token-optimized batchers; expect ~35–50% lower unit cost vs Hosted standard at scale.
- For endpoints that must hit p95 <=600ms: enable streaming only if you accept higher costs due to smaller effective batch sizes; otherwise prefer micro-batching and fast model variant.

Next steps:
- Alex/Priya confirm budget band + preferred p95 for each endpoint
- Send sample traffic CSV (I attached sample_traffic.csv)
- We'll generate 2 pricing scenarios and a PoC SOW draft (attached) for sign-off

Attaching: PoC_SOW_Atlas_v1.pdf, sample_traffic.csv

Thanks — happy to jump on another 30m to walk through numbers.

— Monica
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@atlasanalytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T01:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Token budget & SLO options for PoC with Atlas Analytics

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. Quick answers:
- Budget band for the PoC: aiming for $8k–$12k/month (we can stretch to $15k if the unit economics are compelling).
- Target $/1M tokens: we were thinking $1,200–$1,800 per 1M as acceptable for the PoC; for long-term we want < $1,000 if possible.
- Priority endpoints: "insights" endpoint needs p95 <=550ms; "assistant" can be streaming (p95 can be higher).

I'm uploading a small sample of our traffic as promised — see attached (first 24h). We did notice that a lot of user requests are short prompts with long completions, hence the heavier completion token load.

Let's target a follow-up on Wednesday to run through two pricing scenarios. Can you include an option that assumes 30% caching hit rate vs a conservative 10%? That will affect our unit economics.

— Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T14:20:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL: Recommended PoC configs & ask list (Atlas)

Vivek / Lauren — forwarding the customer's answers. Key points for build:
- Use simulated traffic (attached) with token distribution to produce cost curves for: Hosted standard, Hosted high-throughput, Dedicated small pool.
- Create two pricing scenarios: (A) Conservative caching 10% and (B) Optimistic caching 30%.
- Evaluate: unit cost $/1M tokens, expected monthly bill at 1.2B and 3B tokens, and p95 latency estimates for each tier.
- Simulate streaming impact by reducing batch window from 50ms -> 10ms and recompute throughput/CPI.

Also prep an annotated SOW with milestones: 2-week PoC (ingest traffic + eval), perf tuning week, and roll decision. Attach: PoC_SOW_Atlas_v1.pdf

I'll draft the slides for Wed call — Vivek, can you run the simulation and drop results by EOD Tuesday?

— Monica
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Token budget & SLO options for PoC with Atlas Analytics

Monica — that plan looks good. We confirmed internally and will prioritize the "insights" endpoint for strict SLOs. Priya will review the SOW and come back with comments by Friday.

Couple of quick clarifications for your simulations:
- Please show cost sensitivity to average completion length changing by +/- 20% (we have cases where users ask follow-ups)
- Include a row for "burst cap" behavior — we have spikes up to 2.5x baseline for short periods.

We'll be on the Wed follow-up. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

— Alex
